title: Independent coupling of two input families
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite index set, and let $(\Omega,\mu)$ and $(\Xi,\nu)$ be probability spaces. Suppose $X_i:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ and $Y_i:\Xi\to\mathbb R$ are measurable up to null sets for every $i\in\iota$. There exist a probability space carrying a mutually independent family $(Z_j)_{j\in\iota\sqcup\iota}$ such that each $Z_{\mathrm{inl}(i)}$ has the same distribution as $X_i$ under $\mu$, and each $Z_{\mathrm{inr}(i)}$ has the same distribution as $Y_i$ under $\nu$.
hypotheses_covered: Probability measures $\mu$ and $\nu$ on measurable spaces
Each $X_i$ is measurable up to $\mu$-null sets
Each $Y_i$ is measurable up to $\nu$-null sets
